last_error: SOURCEPOINT_FIRST_LAYER_NO_REJECT: The Sourcepoint first-layer banner on stern.de only offers "Zustimmen und weiter" (Accept All) and "Zum PUR-Abo" (Paid subscription), with no "Reject All" or "Decline" button.
